selection_policy.decision_rule: Select the highest weighted score that does not require new architecture, ambiguous evidence resolution or an unavailable exact source relationship.

candidates.name: Data Products v1.7.0 Release Preparation
candidates.decision: Prepare a new minor public data-product release from the fully green post-brochure baseline. The package reuses the existing deterministic release, download and offline verification pipelines and exposes the accumulated source-backed additions without changing their semantics.

candidates.name: Cross-Model Comparison View Review
candidates.decision: The current release already contains nineteen independent scopes. A new cross-model consumer view is valuable but should be designed after the current source-backed portfolio is published and must continue to prohibit cross-scope inference.

candidates.name: PDF Candidate Extraction Automation Review
candidates.decision: The brochure milestone now provides mature evidence boundaries for candidate extraction, but automation remains a tooling investment and must continue to separate extraction candidates from approved imports.

candidates.name: Exact Configuration Expansion Review
candidates.decision: Do not create configurations or project generic observations without an exact source-backed configuration and relationship.

candidates.name: Ambiguous Brochure Evidence Resolution
candidates.decision: Retain the ambiguity until a source or authoritative clarification provides a stable semantic mapping.

selection.name: Data Products v1.7.0 Release Preparation
selection.rationale: This is the only candidate with immediate consumer delivery value, complete evidence readiness, full reuse of green deterministic tooling and no unresolved dependency. A minor release is appropriate because the documented public baseline remains v1.6.1 while the repository now contains materially expanded official brochure, Duster automatic and Bigster data.

next_package.name: Data Products v1.7.0 Release Preparation
next_package.goal: Freeze the v1.7.0 release version and notes, generate deterministic assets from a green source commit, independently verify download and offline workspace behavior, and prepare exact tag-to-commit publication evidence without changing data semantics.
